targets.conditional: For the CY2027 Census Supplemental Poverty Measure child-poverty outcome, legislation enacted by 2027-12-31 makes the IRC §24(d)(1)(B)(i) earned-income threshold no more than $1 for tax year 2027.
targets.resolutionRule: Resolve to the first Census annual income-and-poverty release artifact for CY2027 using the revised SPM methodology whose identity is authenticated by the registered 2026-07-17 Census announcement: Poverty in the United States: 2027, Supplemental Poverty Measure Table B-2, ALL RACES 2027 row, Under 18 years / Below Poverty / Percent column. The 2028-08-01 through 2028-12-31 expected release window and 2028-12-31 resolve-by deadline are Thesis lab commitments; the announcement does not establish either timing value. Record the published percent without scaling or rounding and ignore later revisions.
